text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One night, I accompany Nishino Flower
to watch
a flower she's been caring for
bloom. Apparently,
it only blooms at
night.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hm... It should bloom any moment now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I usually go to bed at this time, so I'm a
bit
sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I'm going to do my best to stay up
tonight! I
want to be here when this
flower blooms!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Plus... I have a strong feeling it'll bloom
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. If you feel the same, then I'm sure
it'll—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's eyes widen as she looks
at the
bud, which starts to quiver. This is
a clear sign
that it's about to bloom!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Keep going! You're almost there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower and I hold our breaths
and watch
until finally...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The large flower unfurls its petals under
the stars,
and a soft fragrance fills the
air.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The flower gleams as if it's infused with

moonlight. For a while, we simply stare
at the
bloom in awed silence...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for being here with me today,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we got to see the flower
bloom
together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...One day, I want to blossom just like
this flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to shine bright for everyone to
see!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Let's work toward our goal—together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer... Good night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the sight of the glowing flower
will
become an unforgettable memory
for both
Nishino Flower and me.
